headline: Brazil Energy Regulator Aneel Activates Green Tariff Flag for November
summary: Brazilian electricity regulator Aneel announced a green tariff flag for November, citing rainfall in the South and Southeast that replenished hydro reservoir levels.
why: Aneel's tariff flag system dictates surcharges on household and industrial power bills, directly affecting Brazil's monthly IPCA consumer price index.

impacts.name: Brazilian electricity
impacts.why: Activating the green flag removes extra tariff surcharges from electricity bills for November.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
